1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform said computing, and wherein said alignment device is configured to cause a functional change in the computer hardware by modifying the display state of a user interface based on the computed alignment.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and generates a control signal that causes a functional change in the user interface display.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display state that is perceptible to a user.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification by modifying the visual presentation of the current step on the display.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and generates a control signal that causes a functional change in the user interface display.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display state that is perceptible to a user.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification by modifying the visual presentation of the next step on the display.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, and wherein said alignment device compares action sequences rather than individual isolated actions to compute the alignment.

9. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

10. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device modifies its computation based on learned patterns from said previous user experiences.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor comprises a processor executing instructions to parse and identify discrete steps from the documented procedure.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device comprising a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting device and scrolling device cause functional changes in the user interface display state.

14. (Original) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, and wherein the camera and alignment device are integrated to provide real-time feedback.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device modifies its computation based on learned patterns from said previous user experiences.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric using a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, wherein the computing step causes a functional change in a computer system by modifying stored data or display state based on the computed alignment.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and generating a control signal that causes a functional change in a user interface display.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display state.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and generating a control signal that causes a functional change in a user interface display.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display state.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, and wherein the computing step compares action sequences rather than individual isolated actions.

23. (Original) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

25. 26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure using a processor executing instructions to parse and identify discrete steps.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program instructions cause a functional change in the computer hardware by modifying stored data or display state based on the computed alignment.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric using a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display state; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, wherein the scrolling causes a functional change in the user interface display state.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, and wherein the images are processed by a processor to extract action information.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the computing step modifies its computation based on learned patterns from said previous user experiences.

31. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program instructions cause functional changes in the computer hardware by modifying the user interface display state.

32. (Currently amended) The program storage device of claim 31, wherein the program instructions are encoded with a data structure having defined structural and functional interrelationships between the data structure and the computer software and hardware components that permit the data structure's functionality to be realized.
